pyqgis_plugin.name: AutoGIS Studio
pyqgis_plugin.description: Autonomous Geospatial AI Agent for QGIS — 65 Tools across Google Earth Engine, Geospatial Agentic Services (GAS 1.0.0), Sentinel-1 SAR Crop Classification, Raster Building Extraction, India Datasets (Railways, IMD, Census, CPCB), 3D Terrain, Time Series Animation, Multi-LLM OpenRouter Engine, and Live MCP/GAS Server Bridge
pyqgis_plugin.about: AutoGIS Studio is an enterprise-grade, multi-agent geospatial intelligence platform built directly inside QGIS Desktop (3.22–4.x, Qt5 & Qt6 compatible). Powered by 65 autonomous tools, it connects to OpenRouter (300+ LLMs including free tier Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 Lightning with instant 2-5s response), OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Groq, DeepSeek, or local Ollama models. Features include: Native Google Earth Engine (GEE) integration, Geospatial Agentic Services (GAS 1.0.0) standard client & live QGIS server bridge (GetCapabilities, DescribeAgent, ExecuteTask sync/stream, Registry discovery, automatic QGIS layer packaging & spatial artifact auto-loading), Raster Building Footprint Extraction, Sentinel-1 SAR Random Forest crop classification, live OpenStreetMap Overpass vector fetching, Open-Meteo elevation grids, Natural Earth boundaries, India-specific datasets (Indian Railways, IMD Gridded Rainfall/Temp, CPCB Air Quality Index, Census 2011, ISRO Bhuvan WMS/WFS), 3D Terrain Analysis, Flood Inundation Modeling, Viewshed, Hotspot KDE/Gi*, Shortest Path Network Analysis, Zonal Statistics, Surface Interpolation, Animated Time-Series GIFs, PDF/Excel/CSV/DOCX document parsing, automated CRS verification, smart vector symbology, high-DPI PNG map exports, and a bullet-proof PyQGIS console with pre-flight AST validation and safe helper functions.
pyqgis_plugin.external_dependencies: None (pure Python standard library + native PyQGIS)
